pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Iron-Scaled Crimsonback Scorpion inhabits barren deserts and rocky caverns. Its crimson shell is as hard as forged iron. Concealing itself beneath sand and stone during the day, it emerges beneath darkness to hunt. Its sharp tail makes it dangerous even to inexperienced cultivators.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Deserts, badlands, eroded badlands, and dripstone caves. Appears on sand, terracotta, gravel, or dripstone during nighttime or beneath a covered sky.
